text:
evan: Customer reported truncated stream on iOS SDK after intermittent network drop. The streaming session reconnects but the final JSON chunk is missing and there is no finish_reason in the events. Case #CS-4987. Logs + repro below.

kevin: thanks — can you paste minimal repro steps and the SDK + iOS versions? also any headers sent on reconnect?

ev an: repro steps: 1) iPhone (iOS 16.4), Redwood iOS SDK 0.9.2. 2) Start streaming a long completion (~1200 tokens). 3) Turn off cellular for ~3s, then restore. 4) SDK auto-reconnects and sends resume headers: 
```
X-Resume-Id: abc123
X-Resume-Seq: 42
User-Agent: redwood-ios/0.9.2
```
Observed behavior: stream returns until ~token 1186 then stops; client sees connection close without a final event, no finish_reason. The partial buffer is valid JSON up to last emitted chunk but no final sentinel. Customer sees parsing error.

kevin: do you have server-side request/response logs for that timeframe? also does the SDK retry with a different event ID?

ev an: server logs (redacted):
```
[1745554322] conn=xyz123 accept stream start model=chat-large
[1745554328] conn=xyz123 stream-chunk seq=41 emit tokens=1100
[1745554330] conn=xyz123 client-disconnect transient
[1745554335] conn=xyz124 accept resume resume_id=abc123 resume_seq=42
[1745554336] conn=xyz124 stream-chunk seq=42 emit tokens=86
[1745554336] conn=xyz124 flush pending=1 finalize=null
[1745554337] conn=xyz124 connection-close reason=client_closed
```
Note `finalize=null` and then immediate close.

linda: thanks — this looks like a race where the final flush hasn't been persisted/committed before the resumed connection is closed. Two quick suspects: 1) resume_seq mismatch leading runtime to treat the resumed stream as a new ephemeral session and skip finalization, or 2) an intermediate proxy (or client) closing the TCP connection before the last event is fully written to the socket buffer.

kevin: do you see any proxy timeouts around 1745554336-1745554337?

maria: SRE check: we had a spike of short reconnects in region us-east-1 at 1745554300-1745554340 (see alert #A-609). Nginx-front had keepalive_c timeout 200ms configured. That could trigger a tail-drop when the client reconnects quickly.

linda: that aligns. Extra context: SSE clients sometimes re-issue GET with `Last-Event-ID` semantics; our resume header uses `X-Resume-Seq`. If the front proxy or the iOS URLSession coalesces and forcibly closes idle sockets, the last chunk can be lost if we don't flush and wait for the OS send buffer to drain.

kevin: suggested repro curl to simulate resume: 
```
# start original stream
curl -N -H "Accept: text/event-stream" -H "Authorization: Bearer $KEY" "https://api.redwood.ai/v1/streams?model=chat-large" \
  > original.out &
# simulate network drop (kill curl or close connection)
# resume
curl -N -H "Accept: text/event-stream" -H "Authorization: Bearer $KEY" \
  -H "X-Resume-Id: abc123" -H "X-Resume-Seq: 42" \
  "https://api.redwood.ai/v1/streams?model=chat-large" > resume.out
```
This reproduces the truncated final chunk locally when run quickly.

maria: mitigation options: 
- increase proxy keepalive timeout to 2s in us-east-1 to avoid mid-send close.
- add server-side small wait-after-final-chunk (e.g., 300-750ms) before marking finalized when resume headers present.
- instrument finalization ack to client (send explicit `event: finalized\ndata: {"status":"final"}\n\n`

` sentinel so SDK waits for sentinel).

linda: low-risk immediate fix: update iOS SDK to buffer until a final `event: finalized` or until 750ms elapsed after connection close before returning to app parsing layer. Longer-term: we should send an explicit final sentinel from runtime when finishing streaming (even if finish_reason null).

evan: customer confirmed temporary workaround: SDK 0.9.3 branch adds 250ms jitter before resume and waits for a `finalized` sentinel; they say this prevented the truncation in 3/3 repro runs. I'll open a support ticket and link PR to repo.

kevin: please capture these action items:
- SRE: bump keepalive in us-east-1 and monitor alert rate (maria)
- Runtime: add explicit finalize sentinel on completion and ensure flush ack (linda)
- SDK: release patch to wait-for-sentinel + small resume jitter (evan)
- Support: reach back to customer with workaround + ETA

maria: creating incident follow-up doc and will track config rollout.

ev an: thanks all — cc @kevin @linda @maria. Customer case CS-4987 updated with workaround and repro details. :thumbsup:
